prompt_en: Create a photorealistic photograph of one original fictional adult woman firefighter during a chemical-plant emergency-standby inspection in freezing rain. Beside pipes and a foam monitor, she is visibly checking the pressure gauge and coupling on a staged hose line with both gloved hands. In one view, the adult firefighter wears a coordinated turnout protective system: secured helmet with raised clear visor, high-collared flame-resistant coat, reflective trousers, heavy gloves, black boots, and secured air cylinder. Her turnout gear interfaces cleanly with breathing apparatus at protected neck, wrist, ankle, and face junctions. She checks the breathing-apparatus seal and pressure; the pressure gauge confirms the ready state, while the protective configuration matches the declared response task. Keep her face visible beneath the helmet and use the supplied image only as guidance for a calm front-facing facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair tucked securely into the collar, and restrained natural makeup. Frame helmet to boots at eye level, keeping hands, gauge, coupling, protective layers, and plant setting legible in cool storm daylight, restrained red emergency spill, and wet reflections.
